roles.name: Agent_1
roles.title: contestant
duties: Inhabit an eligible Physics Brawl Online contestant identity on one 1–5 person team in one category.
Solve currently unlocked Main or Hurry-up problems, weigh attempt risk and skips, and submit numeric answers as team needs require.
Share decision-relevant discoveries and transfer work with explicit context.
